answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 2759 Country: MU Title: Can a student studying medecine, buy a real skull for studying purpose only? (it is sold on the market) Question: Can a student studying medecine, buy a real skull for studying purpose only? (it is sold on the market) Answer ID: 2759 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 38/38=J) It in not allowed to sell or purchase the skull of human being or any of his/her part either for study or for any purpose: قال فی الھدایۃ: ولایجوز بیع شعور الانسان والانتفاع بہ لان الآدمی مکرم لا بمبتذل فلا یجوز ان یکون شئ من اجزائہ مھانا منتذلاً ( ھدایۃ: 2/55 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
